Issue Summary: Fixing low-contrast at-symbol flagged by WAVE on landing page
Detailed Code Change Description: Removes the dark prop from the material Card header in favor of a targeted text--white class, and drops the hardcoded mid-grey color on .c-environment-info so it inherits a higher-contrast default.

Issue Summary: Multiple nav elements for a single navigation menu
Detailed Code Change Description: allow headings in section navigation, allow mulitple sections in section navigation

Issue Summary: Leaflet attribution flag did not scale properly when users changed the page or browser font size.
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed css component .leaflet-control-attribution svg to .leaflet-attribution-flag, added width and height, and added this attribute to ukrainianFlag variable in control attribution script file.

Issue Summary: Menu reader is inconsistent for some list items do not consist list tags, and role not present for some items.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added li tags for some items for consistency and added roles to improve screen reader and keyboard navigation

Issue Summary: Focus style missing on card
Detailed Code Change Description: Added browser's native focus styles when card is focused and removed focus ring from primary link when card is focused.

Issue Summary: Headers were not defined consequentially.
Did not have reduced motion support.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added reduced motion support by adding collapse.jsx component layer, added three second throttle to enable the option seamlessly, added 0 second transition duration on layer and input css, added support in package.json.

Issue Summary: Links were not underlined, therefore hard to find.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added underline to text decoration in scss files.

Issue Summary: Adding arial label to input component
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds an explicit ariaLabel prop to the Input component, allowing a custom accessible label separate from the visible label text.

Issue Summary: Header bar had contrast issue.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added new inicator element with the color black in css.

Issue Summary: Clear button in UI was missing aria label
Detailed Code Change Description: The variable name for the button was updarted and a descriptive label was added to the element.

Issue Summary: Alert message did not follow accessibility rules.
Detailed Code Change Description: Increased font size, padding, and color contrast for alert message.

Issue Summary: Timeout modal is announced as a different level than it should.
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed time out modal from h1 to h2.

Issue Summary: DAC review issue. Add context to autosuggest results by adding aria-labelledby with the label id provided as the value.
Detailed Code Change Description: added aria-describedby to results <ul>, add label id

Issue Summary: Buttons lacked accessibility
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed from links <a/> without href to proper buttons so they are keyboard accessible

Issue Summary: Enabling outlines on leaflet-container for keyboard users
Detailed Code Change Description: outline-offset added to leaflet-container

Issue Summary: add aria attributes to loaders
Detailed Code Change Description:
- Add aria-valuenow attribute to linear loader
- Add aria-label attribute to both linear and circular loaders
- Add unit tests for loaders

Issue Summary: Improving accessibility on tables by adding captions documentation and scope="col" on thead th
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds scope="col" to every column-header <th> across all table examples in the Bootstrap 4.0 tables docs so assistive technologies can correctly associate header cells with their columns.

Issue Summary: Ensures all elements render correctly in high contrast mode.
Detailed Code Change Description: High contrast mode fixes

Issue Summary: ensure all webpages have readable titles and h1 headings
Detailed Code Change Description: updated the webpages for titles and headings to make them more accessible for screen readers

Issue Summary: The new info badge doesn't provide sufficient colour contrast per AA guidelines in the V5 Alpha 2
Detailed Code Change Description: Four documentation markdown files — badge, card, color, and utilities/colors pages — all using the same template pattern. The fix is identical in each: extend the condition if or (eq .name "light") (eq .name "warning") to also include (eq .name "info").

Issue Summary: Change card headings for better accessibility
Detailed Code Change Description: h4 and h5 are used instead of h1 and h2

Issue Summary: the popup close buttons needs to pass WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) and small visual bug with the outline for keyboard users.
Detailed Code Change Description: fix the width, height, and font size

Issue Summary: Adding keyboard shortcuts to the editor
Detailed Code Change Description: <a> replaced with button and tabIndex added to FileReaderInput

Issue Summary: Dynamically update aria-label for theme switcher
Detailed Code Change Description: set an explicit aria-label to the switcher. Also include the currently selected theme name. Make the theme buttons actual aria-pressed toggles. Set focus explicitly back to the dropdown toggle button after a selection is made

Issue Summary: refactoring induced accessibility issues with change in aria-attributes for new web elements
Detailed Code Change Description: added aria-expanded and assistive text

Issue Summary: tag not read by screenreader correctly
Detailed Code Change Description: changed tag from h3 to strong

Issue Summary: Label/Legend description change
Detailed Code Change Description: margin changed and description added

Issue Summary: Aria labels are hardcoded for nav landmarks and not internationalized.
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds aria-label to nav for internationalization of screen-reader text.

Issue Summary: Decorative SVG icons being announced by screenreader
Detailed Code Change Description: adding an aria-hidden to all SVGs which are for presentation purposes only and should be ignored by assistive tech

Issue Summary: Improves keyboard accessibility by letting assistive technology know which key shortcuts are available through aria-keyshortcuts
Detailed Code Change Description: added ariaKeyShortcuts to keyboard map container

Issue Summary: Add missing role="search" and type="search" in navbar doc and examples
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds role="search" to all navbar search forms across Bootstrap's documentation and examples so assistive technologies can identify them as search landmarks, and changes generic type="text" inputs to semantically correct type="search" in the navbars example.

Issue Summary: Pressing Escape closes entire modal. It should only close dropdown
Detailed Code Change Description: Added condition to close drop-down using escape button.

Issue Summary: List items don't get announced by safari + voiceover
Detailed Code Change Description: Added a list marker so voiceover announces the list items.

Issue Summary: SVG icons did not have the same color as the text following or preceding it when opened in IE11 or Edge.
Detailed Code Change Description: Created a separate high contrast mode scss file that handles svg color fills.

Issue Summary: Adding ARIA labels to footer lists
Detailed Code Change Description: aria-labelledby added to ul

Issue Summary: No accessible labels for notification badge.
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds title and aria-label attributes to icon-only buttons

Issue Summary: Color swatch is too small
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed color swatch width from 3 to 14

Issue Summary: "Hide this" button isnt descriptive to screen reader users
Detailed Code Change Description: Every 'hide this' button used in the details component requires a params.button.contextSuffix value (e.g. 'content') to build a readable string of context for screen readers

Issue Summary: missing img role and aria-label
Detailed Code Change Description: added img role and aria-label to icons

Issue Summary: No skip to content link in the terms of conditions page.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added skip to main if content link has length and added skipLink to index.njk for toc-single and toc-multiple components.

Issue Summary: Tabs weren't keyboard/screen-reader accessible and long labels were truncated with no way to read them.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added arrow-key roving focus and ARIA tablist/tab roles to the Tabs/Tab components, converted Tab to forwardRef, and wrapped overflowing labels in a tooltip.

Issue Summary: Modal dialog accessibility issues occurs for incorrect use of document role.
Detailed Code Change Description: Removed role="document" for modal dialog.

Issue Summary: The TOC component lacks the ability to set a custom aria-label for related links.
Detailed Code Change Description: Removes role="complementary" as this is no longer needed (redundant when using <aside>). Adds ariaLabel param to the relatedLinks block of TOC component

Issue Summary: Headers were not defined consequentially.
Detailed Code Change Description: Changed a few headers from h4 to h3.

Issue Summary: Improves screen reader support for list
Detailed Code Change Description: Adds <label> elements with id attributes and connects them to each ef-list via aria-labelledby.

Issue Summary: Links are announced with irrelevant description.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added blank aria label to a component, and aria-hidden=True

Issue Summary: Some icons did not contain aria-labels.
Detailed Code Change Description: Added aria-label attribute to icons.

Issue Summary: VO always announce percentage value in number-field when open in Safari. To make VO+Safari announced correct value, the document in MDN suggests to include aria-valuetext with aria-valuenow to prevent it from announced value as percentage when aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax are not defined.
Detailed Code Change Description: add aria-valuetext

Issue Summary: improve screen reader support
Detailed Code Change Description: replace aria-label with aria-description
